formTitle: DV-145 Order to Prevent Child Abduction
_comment: DV-145 is the judge's order on the DV-108 request - "This is a Court Order." at the foot of both pages - and its first line says "This form is attached to DV-140, Child Custody and Visitation Order." The filer prepares items 1 and 2 (the two names and their relationships to the children, carrying DV-105's names exactly as DV-140 does) and the proposed orders in items 4-10, which are DV-108 items 4-10 box for box and carry DV-108's names, so the orders the filer asked for there are the orders printed here and nothing is asked twice. The judge completes the rest: item 3 is headed "Court's Decision" (the findings), item 4's choice of area, item 11 (enforcement) and item 12 (other orders and jurisdiction), and the case number is the clerk's. The form has no court name, lawyer, children or signature box. Court fields are named dv145_court_ from what they print, so none shares a filer name. Names come from the widget rectangles checked against the printed text; the label tool read item 6's five boxes one line off.

fields._why: The case number is the clerk's on every form in this packet - DV-100 prints "Court fills in case number when form is filed."

fields.label: 2. Relationship to children - Parent
fields._why: Item 2 numbers its boxes out of printed order: [1] sits beside Parent, [2] beside Legal Guardian and [0] beside Other (read from the widget rectangles).

fields.label: 3a. There is not a risk that the person in 2 might take the children without proper permission
fields._why: Item 3 is headed "Court's Decision": "Based on the information given, the judge finds that" - a finding the judge makes, not a fact the filer supplies. The filer's reasons are on DV-108 item 3, under DV-108's own names; this box must not carry them or the filer's claim would print as the judge's finding.

fields.label: 4. Do Not Move Without Written Permission of the Other Parent or Court Order
fields._why: The same order DV-108 item 4 asks for ("not move with our children without my written permission or the judge's permission"), so it carries DV-108's name and is ticked by that answer.

fields.label: 4. Must not move with the children outside - This county
fields._why: Item 4 reads "The person in 2 must not move with the children outside [this county / California / The United States / Other]". DV-108 item 4, the filer's request, asks only that they not move the children without permission and gives no choice of area; how far the order reaches is the judge's to decide.
